test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is, **'fitness**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fitness** means **being healthy and in good shape**.

 
 
• Example - ***Jogging every day is good for fitness***.
 
 
 
• The correct sentence would be, **Health and fitness are inextricably linked and we must concentrate on maintaining our health and fitness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Flatness** means** a surface without raised areas**.

 
 
• Example - ***The flatness of this desert amazes me.***
 
 
 
• **Fineness** means **the state of something staying real or pure*****.***
 
 
• Example -*** The fineness of these swords made them valuable even during the old era.***
 
 
 
• **Fatness** means **having excessive weight**.
 
 
• Example - ***The fatness of this toe raises doubts***.
